decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The details of arrangements for storing waste and recycling from the development, as shown on drawings numbered A CD (00) 02 Rev. A and A CD (00) 06, received 28 March 2008, pursuant to condition 6 of planning permission 00229/P/P25 dated 19 February 2008, are satisfactory and approval is recommended without the addition of further conditions.

Reason for Approval:

The details submitted pursuant to condition 6 of the planning permission, giving details of arrangements for storing waste and recycling from the development, are satisfactory as they would provide satisfactory facilities for the development and the living conditions of neighbouring residents would be adequately protected.
description: Following approval for the demolition of the existing building and erection of three new buildings and associated parking and landscaping with flexible permission for use as a motor vehicle hire centre (sui generis) and B1(c), B2 and B8 uses with ancillary office space for Unit A (occupying the southern part of site) and B1(c), B2 and B8 uses with ancillary office space for Units B and C (occupying the centre and northern part of the site) details submitted pursuant to Condition 6 (Storage bins) of permission dated 19/2/08
